name: Bookmarks' playlist export (1.5.0 / 2.3.0): a playlist's Export to clips folder button, opened with the keyboard; the dialog's facts (videos, left-out items with their reasons, running time, size and frame rate, estimate, file name) at desktop width and as a phone bottom sheet with touch-sized buttons; Export, the progress in the dialog and on My Clips under Playlist exports, Cancel there (the export ends Cancelled); and a short export's Export ready toast. Makes two playlists named 'Export webcheck ...' of the sandbox's Export test videos (Movies/Export Small, Silent and Large, and Gone when it is there) and Long Test Movie; deletes earlier ones first (sandbox data only).

steps.name: make the two playlists (earlier ones deleted)
steps.script: const uid = ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(); const url = (p, q) => ApiClient.getUrl(p, q); const old = await ApiClient.getItems(uid, { IncludeItemTypes: 'Playlist', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Export webcheck' }); for (const p of old.Items) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: url('Items/' + p.Id) }); } const movies = (await ApiClient.getItems(uid, { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, Limit: 500 })).Items; const id = (n) => (movies.find(m => m.Name.startsWith(n)) || {}).Id; const make = async (name, ids) => (await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: url('Playlists'), data: JSON.stringify({ Name: name, Ids: ids.filter(Boolean), UserId: uid, MediaType: 'Video', IsPublic: false }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' })).Id; const long = id('Long Test Movie'); return { short: await make('Export webcheck [road trip]', [id('Export Small'), id('Export Silent'), id('Export Gone'), id('Export Large')]), long: await make('Export webcheck long', [id('Versions Movie'), long, long, long, long, long]) };

steps.name: both made
steps.message: the playlists weren't made (are the Export test videos in Movies?)

steps.name: Export to clips folder is on the page
focus it
steps.script: const b = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-export-playlist'); b.focus(); return { title: b.title, focused: document.activeElement === b };

steps.name: what the dialog says
steps.script: const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); const facts = Object.fromEntries([...p.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-export-fact')].map(f => [f.querySelector('.jfbm-export-fact-label').textContent, f.querySelector('.jfbm-export-fact-value').textContent])); const skipped = [...p.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-export-skipped li')].map(li => li.textContent); const start = p.querySelector('.jfbm-export-start'); const m = { title: p.querySelector('h3').textContent, facts, skipped, startEnabled: !start.disabled, focusInDialog: p.contains(document.activeElement) }; m.ok = m.title === 'Export to clips folder' && Object.keys(facts).length >= 5 && /^Export webcheck \(road trip\)( \(\d+\))?\.mp4$/.test(Object.values(facts).find(v => /\.mp4$/.test(v)) || '') && skipped.every(s => / – /.test(s)) && m.startEnabled && m.focusInDialog; return m;

steps.name: a bottom sheet, one column of facts, touch-sized buttons, nothing wider than the screen
steps.script: const b = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop'); const p = b.querySelector('.jfbm-panel'); const r = p.getBoundingClientRect(); const buttons = [...p.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-export-cancel, .jfbm-export-start')].map(x => { const q = x.getBoundingClientRect(); return [x.textContent, Math.round(q.width), Math.round(q.height)]; }); const m = { panel: [Math.round(r.left), Math.round(r.right), Math.round(r.bottom)], viewport: [innerWidth, innerHeight], columns: getComputedStyle(p.querySelector('.jfbm-export-facts')).gridTemplateColumns, buttons, scrollWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth }; m.ok = m.panel[0] === 0 && m.panel[1] === innerWidth && Math.abs(m.panel[2] - innerHeight) <= 1 && m.columns.split(' ').length === 1 && buttons.length === 2 && buttons.every(([, , h]) => h >= 40) && m.scrollWidth <= Math.max(innerWidth, __vars.pageWidth.scrollWidth) && [...p.querySelectorAll('*')].every(e => e.getBoundingClientRect().right <= innerWidth + 0.5); return m;

steps.name: open the dialog
steps.script: for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); const b = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-export-playlist'); if (b && b.isConnected && !document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop')) { b.click(); return true; } } return false;

steps.name: the dialog shows the progress
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); const bar = p && p.querySelector('.jfbm-export-progress'); return !!bar && Number(bar.getAttribute('aria-valuenow') || 0) > 0 && !!p.querySelector('.jfbm-export-stop'); })()

steps.name: Playlist exports lists it with its progress and Cancel
steps.waitFor: (() => { const row = [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-exports .jfbm-export-row')].find(r => r.textContent.includes('Export webcheck long')); return !!row && !!row.querySelector('.jfbm-export-row-cancel') && Number((row.querySelector('.jfbm-export-progress') || { getAttribute: () => 0 }).getAttribute('aria-valuenow') || 0) > 0; })()

steps.name: it ends Cancelled
steps.waitFor: (() => { const row = [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-exports .jfbm-export-row')].find(r => r.textContent.includes('Export webcheck long')); return !!row && /Cancelled/.test(row.textContent) && !row.querySelector('.jfbm-export-row-cancel'); })()

steps.name: the server says Cancelled
steps.script: const jobs = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Exports')); const job = jobs.find(j => j.PlaylistId === __vars.playlists.long); return { state: job && job.State, ok: !!job && job.State === 'Cancelled' && !job.FileSize };
